title: VideoSeek: Long-Horizon Video Agent with Tool-Guided Seeking

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if AI could watch hours of video in seconds?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Video agentic models are hitting their limits with long videos.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: VideoSeek uses tool-guided seeking to jump straight to key moments.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It skips over boring parts using a map of the video’s content.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This helps researchers and creators find insights faster than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The future of video analysis is smarter, not just faster.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you seen a video that changed your mind?
